mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.product_name, p.category_id, c.category_name, p.merchant_id, m.merchant_name, m.region, p.price, p.stock, p.image, p.description, p.status, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM product p JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id JOIN merchant m ON p.merchant_id = m.id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.status = 1
SELECT stock FROM product WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
